scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace @local-creative-os/web && npm run lint --workspace @local-creative-os/local-core && npm run lint --workspace @local-creative-os/domain && npm run lint --workspace @local-creative-os/contracts
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace @local-creative-os/web && npm run typecheck --workspace @local-creative-os/local-core && npm run typecheck --workspace @local-creative-os/domain && npm run typecheck --workspace @local-creative-os/contracts
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace @local-creative-os/web && npm run test --workspace @local-creative-os/local-core && npm run test --workspace @local-creative-os/domain && npm run test --workspace @local-creative-os/contracts
scripts.test:report: vitest run apps/web/tests apps/local-core/tests packages/domain/tests packages/contracts/tests --reporter=json --outputFile=public/dev-test-report.json

scripts.check:phase25: npm run check:fast && npm run test:integration && npm run test:e2e
